system_instruction:
[STRUCTURAL DECOUPLING, GEOMETRY LOCK & STATIC RECTIFICATION CONTRACT]
- GEOMETRY LOCK: Treat all architectural geometry as an immutable physical frame. Every column, window recess, sash mullion, cornice, balustrade, and ashlar course must remain razor-sharp and structurally intact. Zero geometric melting, AI smoothing, or warping.
- STATIC DECLUTTERING (MANDATORY): COMPLETELY ERASE all transient vehicles, parked cars, delivery vans, pedestrians, wheelie bins, and temporary street clutter from the seed image. Repaint the carriageway with authentic road surfacing, whinstone kerbs, and clean flagstone pavements.
- BOTANICAL PHENOLOGY & CANOPY INTEGRITY (IMMUTABLE): Zero summer hallucinations during winter/dormant dates. Render true deciduous defoliation, bare branch ramification, and species-specific dormancy:
  Drummond Place Gardens features mature urban woodland enclosed by perimeter wrought-iron railings. Canopy species: *Ulmus glabra* (Wych elm), *Platanus × acerifolia* (London plane), *Acer pseudoplatanus* (Sycamore maple), *Fagus sylvatica* (European beech), and *Tilia × europaea* (Common lime). Date phenology (November 11): Advanced late-autumn senescence with 75% to 85% defoliation; stark branch architectures and fractal limb systems exposed; remaining leaves present as sparse russet, ochre, and deep umber patches; garden lawn surfaces are covered in damp fallen leaf litter.
- OPTICAL FIDELITY: Pin-sharp infinite depth of field (f/11). Zero lens blur, tilt-shift, or depth-of-field falloff.
user_prompt:
[SOLAR & ATMOSPHERIC LIGHTING OVERRIDE]
SOLAR LIGHT VECTOR (4500K Late afternoon raking sunlight with warm golden highlights): Sun background upper-left (Azimuth 188.2°, Elevation 16.5°). backlit silhouettes with left rim lighting. shadows project forward toward lower-RIGHT.

[SCENE GEOMETRY & AUTHENTIC LITHICS]
High-angle 6x7 medium format architectural documentary survey of Edinburgh's Drummond Place and Albany Street Georgian terraces. Rigid rectilinear and crescent facades of pale buff Craigleith and grey Hailes sandstone ashlar, perfectly plumbed to vertical alignment. Ground levels show channelled stone rustication with sunken basement lightwells crossed by stone platts and cast-iron spearhead railings. Upper tiers display disciplined grids of 6-over-6 timber sash-and-case windows framed by crisp moulded architraves. Roofscape defined by pitch-aligned Ballachulish slate roofs, lead ridge flashings, regular piended dormers, and ashlar chimney stacks crowned with terracotta cylindrical flue pots. Enclosed central park of Drummond Place Gardens contains mature *Ulmus glabra*, *Platanus × acerifolia*, *Acer pseudoplatanus*, and *Fagus sylvatica* trees displaying mid-November late-autumn phenology with heavy leaf loss, revealing complex dark branch architectures with sparse residual russet foliage over damp grass. Carriageways paved in continuous dark grey whinstone setts bordered by Caithness stone flagstone pavements and basalt kerbing. Weathering manifests as localized carbon soot crusts under cornices and water-washed ashlar stone surfaces. Static civil infrastructure only; completely free of vehicles, people, and street clutter.
